# Drop-in replacements for retiring APIs, plus data tools

> Keep code working after Perspective, Azure Content Moderator and whisper-1 shut down: same requests, same JSON. Plus App Store reviews and Woolworths data.

## Pages

- [Stop AI coding agents installing hallucinated packages](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/ai-agent-hallucinated-packages/): Block npm and PyPI installs of packages that do not exist (slopsquatting) in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor, and check APIs against the exact version.
- [App Store Reviews Scraper: any app, no Connect key](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/app-store-reviews-scraper/): Export Apple App Store reviews and app details for any app and country as JSON or CSV, from Apple's public feed. No Connect key. $0.20 per 1,000 rows.
- [Azure Content Moderator retirement (Mar 15, 2027): drop-in API](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/azure-content-moderator-alternative/): Yes, Azure Content Moderator retires March 15, 2027 and Content Safety is a different API. Keep ProcessText/Screen code: same request, same JSON, new host. $1 per 1,000.
- [Azure Content Moderator vs Content Safety: what changes (2027)](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/azure-content-moderator-to-content-safety/): Content Moderator retires March 15, 2027. Field-by-field: what ProcessText/Screen returned, what Content Safety's text:analyze returns, and what has no equivalent.
- [Drop-in replacements for retiring APIs, plus data tools](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/): Keep code working after Perspective, Azure Content Moderator and whisper-1 shut down: same requests, same JSON. Plus App Store reviews and Woolworths data.
- [OpenAI removes whisper-1 and gpt-4o-transcribe on Feb 26, 2027](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/openai-transcription-models-deprecation-2027/): whisper-1, gpt-4o-transcribe, gpt-4o-mini-transcribe and gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize leave the OpenAI API on Feb 26, 2027. Which replacement to use, and what each one keeps.
- [Perspective API shutdown (Dec 31, 2026): drop-in replacement](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/perspective-api-alternative/): Yes, Google's Perspective API shuts down after Dec 31, 2026, with no migration support. Keep the same comments:analyze request and JSON: change the host and key. $1 per 1,000.
- [Perspective API shutdown checklist: migrate before Dec 31, 2026](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/perspective-api-shutdown-checklist/): Step-by-step checklist to migrate off Google's Perspective API before it stops after Dec 31, 2026: find every call, pick a replacement, re-tune thresholds, cut over.
- [whisper-1 deprecation (Feb 26, 2027): keep SRT, VTT, timestamps](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/whisper-1-alternative/): Yes, OpenAI removes whisper-1 on Feb 26, 2027. Keep /v1/audio/transcriptions with SRT, VTT and word timestamps: change base_url and api_key. $0.006 per minute.
- [Woolworths API: Australian grocery prices as JSON](https://alidaram99.github.io/api-alternatives/woolworths-api/): Woolworths Australia product prices, specials and unit prices (per kg or litre) by search term, as JSON or CSV. Public catalog data. $1 per 1,000 items.
